name: Omni-Channel Campaign Creation & Launch Blueprint
purpose: Deploy high-converting campaigns across Google, Meta, and TikTok using industry template guidelines, validated tracking, and human approval gates.
triggerConditions: User prompt requesting campaign creation or launch
New product line launch execution plan
prerequisites: Target ad account verified and active
Creative assets adhering to platform format specifications ready
Campaign budget defined and within client monthly budget cap

executionSteps.name: Audit Tracking Readiness
executionSteps.action: Ensure target optimization events (Purchase/Lead) are firing and deduplicated before committing ad spend

executionSteps.name: Synthesize Creative & Ad Copy Structure
executionSteps.action: Match creative assets to aspect ratio guidelines (9:16 for Reels/TikTok, 1:1 for Feeds, 16:9 for YouTube) and generate compliant copy

executionSteps.name: Construct Draft Campaign Hierarchy
executionSteps.action: Build Campaign, AdSets/AdGroups, and Ad units in PAUSED state using naming conventions and bidding guardrails

executionSteps.name: Risk & Policy Compliance Check
executionSteps.action: Scan ad copy against platform policies (Healthcare, Housing, Credit, Trademarks) and verify budget cap

executionSteps.name: Human Approval Gate
executionSteps.action: Submit plan to ActionQueue for explicit user sign-off before activating spend

executionSteps.name: Activate & Confirm Delivery
executionSteps.action: Set campaign status to ACTIVE via platform adapter upon user approval and verify initial impression delivery

expectedOutputs: Live Campaign IDs across Google, Meta, and TikTok
successCriteria: Campaign successfully mounted in ACTIVE status
First impressions registered within 2 hours of launch
Zero policy disprovals or ad rejections by platform automated reviewers

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry API mutation once if transient network fault; abort immediately if platform returns policy disapproval

rollbackStrategy: Immediately pause all newly created campaigns, ad sets, and ads across all platforms to prevent budget depletion.
